scope: Paper development commands. This reservation does not alter atlas-wide data availability.
decision_basis: Published test-program metadata and pressure/density coverage, before downloading or analyzing TMD6-25 response files in this paper work.
prior_exposure: TMD1-5 already used in the transfer demonstration and development pilot.
All TMU1-12 response files were read in the initial audit; they remain development data.
Published figures and test-program tables were available and inspected; no genuinely blind-data claim.
Published KFS parameter sets may encode knowledge of these tests. Such transfers need a separate baseline track and cannot establish independent held-out calibration.
release_rule: Reserved tests stay excluded from development calibration, scoring and plotting. A later scientific protocol must explicitly record release after freezing models, bounds, objectives, algorithms and analysis rules; no release command is implemented here.
grouping_limit: Density bands are descriptive test groups, not verified independent preparation batches. Do not derive independent-sample confidence intervals from these groups.
